fusions.name: Weighted Kick
fusions.desc: A quick kick weighted with a loop of chain that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fleeing Whipcrack
fusions.desc: A long lash at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Slipped Halter
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood. You also have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Yanked Aside
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that failed is rolled again.
